svg.title: Campus Water Week tablet and mobile wireframes
svg.desc: Hand-sketched tablet and mobile game layouts showing how the seven-day campaign, action selection, live stats, resources, and finished-week results adapt to smaller screens.
svg.text: RESPONSIVE WIREFRAMES / SAME CAMPAIGN, DIFFERENT SCREEN SIZES
≤ 900 px · compact two-column game · 2 action cards per row
≤ 640 px · one-column game · thumb-friendly, vertical flow
IN-PROGRESS GAME / LANDSCAPE OR NARROW DESKTOP
Build a campus movement for clean water. Rally your people and make this week count.
PICK YOUR PLAY · ONE ACTION TODAY
More actions below — scroll to see all 14 available moves.
Selected move · 1 volunteer hour · no budget cost
Choose a move, then confirm to spend today’s turn.
A live confirmation reports the outcome; continue for Days 5–7.
TABLET SIDEBAR / STAYS BESIDE THE GAME
Your campus crew showed up. Here’s the seven-day result.
Your best score is saved for your next run.
Close × · replay starts a new campaign.
Build a campus movement for clean water.
Rally your people and make this week count.
Scrollable two-column choices; cards include cost, gains, and risk.
Confirm to use today’s one campaign action.
STATS & RESOURCES FOLLOW THE ACTIONS ON MOBILE
MOBILE END-OF-WEEK STATE / COMPACT, SCROLL-SAFE DIALOG
Your campus crew showed up. Here’s what
you built together in seven days.
Best score saved for your next campaign.
Close × · play again to start a new run.
Both sizes retain all seven days, one action per day, resource costs, live feedback, a restart control, and the final score.
Tablet keeps score beside play; mobile stacks score after the actions, with resources and legacy directly beneath.
